summary: Implemented `Perc` in `seaborn._stats.order`, exported it through `seaborn.objects`, and documented it in the API reference and v0.12.1 release notes. Added tests for levels, methods, orientation, grouping order, missing values, public import, and `Plot.add`. All 45 stats/object tests passed; the focused `Perc` tests also passed after the final test adjustment.
